claims.text: The FDA amphetamine label says amphetamines with SSRIs, the class containing citalopram, may cause potentially life-threatening serotonin syndrome.
claims.quote: Serotonin syndrome, a potentially life-threatening reaction, may occur when amphetamines are used in combination with other drugs that affect the serotonergic neurotransmitter systems such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs)

headline.text: The FDA amphetamine label flags serotonin syndrome with SSRIs, the class containing citalopram.

reported.text: The label describes the reaction as potentially life-threatening and addresses SSRIs as a class.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human study specifically testing amphetamine with citalopram.
